title: I John 3:5
text: And ye know that he was manifested to take away sins; and in him is no sin.

title: I John 3:6
text: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither knoweth him.

title: I John 3:7
text: [My] little children, let no man lead you astray: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous:

title: I John 3:8
text: he that doeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. To this end was the Son of God manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

title: I John 3:9
text: Whosoever is begotten of God doeth no sin, because his seed abideth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is begotten of God.

title: I John 3:10
text: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.

title: I John 3:11
text: For this is the message which ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another:

title: I John 3:12
text: not as Cain was of the evil one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his works were evil, and his brother's righteous.

title: I John 3:13
text: Marvel not, brethren, if the world hateth you.

title: I John 3:14
text: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not abideth in death.

title: I John 3:15
text: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.

title: I John 3:16
text: Hereby know we love, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.

title: I John 3:17
text: But whoso hath the world's goods, and beholdeth his brother in need, and shutteth up his compassion from him, how doth the love of God abide in him?

title: I John 3:18
text: [My] Little children, let us not love in word, neither with the tongue; but in deed and truth.

title: I John 3:19
text: Hereby shall we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our heart before him:

title: I John 3:20
text: because if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

title: I John 3:21
text: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, we have boldness toward God;

title: I John 3:22
text: and whatsoever we ask we receive of him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

title: I John 3:23
text: And this is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he gave us commandment.

title: I John 3:24
text: And he that keepeth his commandments abideth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

title: I John 4:1
text: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but prove the spirits, whether they are of God; because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

title: I John 4:2
text: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:

title: I John 4:3
text: and every spirit that confesseth not Jesus is not of God: and this is the [spirit] of the antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it cometh; and now it is in the world already.

title: I John 4:4
text: Ye are of God, [my] little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world.

title: I John 4:5
text: They are of the world: therefore speak they [as] of the world, and the world heareth them.

title: I John 4:6
text: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he who is not of God heareth us not. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

title: I John 4:7
text: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is begotten of God, and knoweth God.

title: I John 4:8
text: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

title: I John 4:9
text: Herein was the love of God manifested in us, that God hath sent his only begotten Son into the world that we might live through him.

title: I John 4:10
text: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son [to be] the propitiation for our sins.

title: I John 4:11
text: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

title: I John 4:12
text: No man hath beheld God at any time: if we love one another, God abideth in us, and his love is perfected in us:

title: I John 4:13
text: hereby we know that we abide in him and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.

title: I John 4:14
text: And we have beheld and bear witness that the Father hath sent the Son [to be] the Saviour of the world.

title: I John 4:15
text: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God abideth in him, and he in God.

title: I John 4:16
text: And we know and have believed the love which God hath in us. God is love; and he that abideth in love abideth in God, and God abideth in him.

title: I John 4:17
text: Herein is love made perfect with us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment; because as he is, even so are we in this world.

title: I John 4:18
text: There is no fear in love: but perfect love casteth out fear, because fear hath punishment; and he that feareth is not made perfect in love.

title: I John 4:19
text: We love, because he first loved us.

title: I John 4:20
text: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, cannot love God whom he hath not seen.

title: I John 4:21
text: And this commandment have we from him, that he who loveth God love his brother also.

title: I John 5:1
text: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is begotten of God: and whosoever loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.

title: I John 5:2
text: Hereby we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and do his commandments.

title: I John 5:3
text: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.

title: I John 5:4
text: For whatsoever is begotten of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that hath overcome the world, [even] our faith.

title: I John 5:5
text: And who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?

title: I John 5:6
text: This is he that came by water and blood, [even] Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and with the blood.

title: I John 5:7
text: And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is the truth.

title: I John 5:8
text: For there are three who bear witness, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and the three agree in one.

title: I John 5:9
text: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for the witness of God is this, that he hath borne witness concerning his Son.

title: I John 5:10
text: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in him: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he hath not believed in the witness that God hath borne concerning his Son.

title: I John 5:11
text: And the witness is this, that God gave unto us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

title: I John 5:12
text: He that hath the Son hath the life; he that hath not the Son of God hath not the life.

title: I John 5:13
text: These things have I written unto you, that ye may know that ye have eternal life, [even] unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God.

title: I John 5:14
text: And this is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he heareth us:

title: I John 5:15
text: and if we know that he heareth us whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

title: I John 5:16
text: If any man see his brother sinning a sin not unto death, he shall ask, and [God] will give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: not concerning this do I say that he should make request.

title: I John 5:17
text: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.

title: I John 5:18
text: We know that whosoever is begotten of God sinneth not; but he that was begotten of God keepeth himself, and the evil one toucheth him not.

title: I John 5:19
text: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in the evil one.

title: I John 5:20
text: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, [even] in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

title: I John 5:21
text: [My] little children, guard yourselves from idols.

title: II John 1:1
text: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in truth; and not I only, but also all they that know the truth;

title: II John 1:2
text: for the truth's sake which abideth in us, and it shall be with us for ever:

title: II John 1:3
text: Grace, mercy, peace shall be with us, from God the Father, and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

title: II John 1:4
text: I rejoice greatly that I have found [certain] of thy children walking in truth, even as we received commandment from the Father.

title: II John 1:5
text: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote to thee a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

title: II John 1:6
text: And this is love, that we should walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, even as ye heard from the beginning, that ye should walk in it.

title: II John 1:7
text: For many deceivers are gone forth into the world, [even] they that confess not that Jesus Christ cometh in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the antichrist.

title: II John 1:8
text: Look to yourselves, that ye lose not the things which we have wrought, but that ye receive a full reward.

title: II John 1:9
text: Whosoever goeth onward and abideth not in the teaching of Christ, hath not God: he that abideth in the teaching, the same hath both the Father and the Son.

title: II John 1:10
text: If any one cometh unto you, and bringeth not this teaching, receive him not into [your] house, and give him no greeting:

title: II John 1:11
text: for he that giveth him greeting partaketh in his evil works.

title: II John 1:12
text: Having many things to write unto you, I would not [write them] with paper and ink: but I hope to come unto you, and to speak face to face, that your joy may be made full.

title: II John 1:13
text: The children of thine elect sister salute thee.

title: III John 1:1
text: The elder unto Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.

title: III John 1:2
text: Beloved, I pray that in all things thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.

title: III John 1:3
text: For I rejoiced greatly, when brethren came and bare witness unto thy truth, even as thou walkest in truth.

title: III John 1:4
text: Greater joy have I none than this, to hear of my children walking in the truth.

title: III John 1:5
text: Beloved, thou doest a faithful work in whatsoever thou doest toward them that are brethren and strangers withal;

title: III John 1:6
text: who bare witness to thy love before the church: whom thou wilt do well to set forward on their journey worthily of God:

title: III John 1:7
text: because that for the sake of the Name they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.

title: III John 1:8
text: We therefore ought to welcome such, that we may be fellow-workers for the truth.

title: III John 1:9
text: I wrote somewhat unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.

title: III John 1:10
text: Therefore, if I come, I will bring to remembrance his works which he doeth, prating against us with wicked words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and them that would he forbiddeth and casteth [them] out of the church.

title: III John 1:11
text: Beloved, imitate not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: he that doeth evil hath not seen God.

title: III John 1:12
text: Demetrius hath the witness of all [men], and of the truth itself: yea, we also bear witness: and thou knowest that our witness is true.

title: III John 1:13
text: I had many things to write unto thee, but I am unwilling to write [them] to thee with ink and pen:

title: III John 1:14
text: but I hope shortly to see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace [be] unto thee. The friends salute thee. Salute the friends by name.

title: Jude 1:1
text: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are called, beloved in God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:

title: Jude 1:2
text: Mercy unto you and peace and love be multiplied.

title: Jude 1:3
text: Beloved, while I was giving all diligence to write unto you of our common salvation, I was constrained to write unto you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered unto the saints.

title: Jude 1:4
text: For there are certain men crept in privily, [even] they who were of old written of beforehand unto this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.

title: Jude 1:5
text: Now I desire to put you in remembrance, though ye know all things once for all, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.

title: Jude 1:6
text: And angels that kept not their own principality, but left their proper habitation, he hath kept in everlasting bonds under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

title: Jude 1:7
text: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the cities about them, having in like manner with these given themselves over to fornication and gone after strange flesh, are set forth as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.

title: Jude 1:8
text: Yet in like manner these also in their dreamings defile the flesh, and set at nought dominion, and rail at dignities.

title: Jude 1:9
text: But Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing judgment, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.

title: Jude 1:10
text: But these rail at whatsoever things they know not: and what they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason, in these things are they destroyed.

title: Jude 1:11
text: Woe unto them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in the gainsaying of Korah.

title: Jude 1:12
text: These are they who are hidden rocks in your love-feasts when they feast with you, shepherds that without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn leaves without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

title: Jude 1:13
text: Wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness hath been reserved forever.

title: Jude 1:14
text: And to these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,

title: Jude 1:15
text: to execute judgment upon all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have ungodly wrought, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

title: Jude 1:16
text: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their lusts (and their mouth speaketh great swelling [words]), showing respect of persons for the sake of advantage.

title: Jude 1:17
text: But ye, beloved, remember ye the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;

title: Jude 1:18
text: That they said to you, In the last time there shall be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.

title: Jude 1:19
text: These are they who make separations, sensual, having not the Spirit.

title: Jude 1:20
text: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,

title: Jude 1:21
text: keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.

title: Jude 1:22
text: And on some have mercy, who are in doubt;

title: Jude 1:23
text: and some save, snatching them out of the fire; and on some have mercy with fear; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.

title: Jude 1:24
text: Now unto him that is able to guard you from stumbling, and to set you before the presence of his glory without blemish in exceeding joy,

title: Jude 1:25
text: to the only God our Saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, [be] glory, majesty, dominion and power, before all time, and now, and for evermore. Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:1
text: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show unto his servants, [even] the things which must shortly come to pass: and he sent and signified [it] by his angel unto his servant John;

title: Revelation of John 1:2
text: who bare witness of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, [even] of all things that he saw.

title: Revelation of John 1:3
text: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written therein: for the time is at hand.

title: Revelation of John 1:4
text: John to the seven churches that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace, from him who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits that are before his throne;

title: Revelation of John 1:5
text: and from Jesus Christ, [who is] the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loveth us, and loosed us from our sins by his blood;

title: Revelation of John 1:6
text: and he made us [to be] a kingdom, [to be] priests unto his God and Father; to him [be] the glory and the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:7
text: Behold, he cometh with the clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they that pierced him; and all the tribes of the earth shall mourn over him. Even so, Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:8
text: I am the Alpha and the Omega, saith the Lord God, who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.

title: Revelation of John 1:9
text: I John, your brother and partaker with you in tribulation and kingdom and patience [which are] in Jesus, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.

title: Revelation of John 1:10
text: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and I heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet

title: Revelation of John 1:11
text: saying, What thou seest, write in a book and send [it] to the seven churches: unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamum, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.

title: Revelation of John 1:12
text: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And having turned I saw seven golden candlesticks;

title: Revelation of John 1:13
text: and in the midst of the candlesticks one like unto a son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about at the breasts with a golden girdle.

title: Revelation of John 1:14
text: And his head and his hair were white as white wool, [white] as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;

title: Revelation of John 1:15
text: and his feet like unto burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace; and his voice as the voice of many waters.

title: Revelation of John 1:16
text: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.

title: Revelation of John 1:17
text: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as one dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying, Fear not; I am the first and the last,

title: Revelation of John 1:18
text: and the Living one; and I was dead, and behold, I am alive for evermore, and I have the keys of death and of Hades.

title: Revelation of John 1:19
text: Write therefore the things which thou sawest, and the things which are, and the things which shall come to pass hereafter;

title: Revelation of John 1:20
text: the mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks are seven churches.

title: Revelation of John 2:1
text: To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, he that walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks:

title: Revelation of John 2:2
text: I know thy works, and thy toil and patience, and that thou canst not bear evil men, and didst try them that call themselves apostles, and they are not, and didst find them false;

title: Revelation of John 2:3
text: and thou hast patience and didst bear for my name's sake, and hast not grown weary.

title: Revelation of John 2:4
text: But I have [this] against thee, that thou didst leave thy first love.

title: Revelation of John 2:5
text: Remember therefore whence thou art fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I come to thee, and will move thy candlestick out of its place, except thou repent.

title: Revelation of John 2:6
text: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

title: Revelation of John 2:7
text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches. To him that overcometh, to him will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of God.

title: Revelation of John 2:8
text: And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These things saith the first and the last, who was dead, and lived [again]:

title: Revelation of John 2:9
text: I know thy tribulation, and thy poverty (but thou art rich), and the blasphemy of them that say they are Jews, and they art not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

title: Revelation of John 2:10
text: Fear not the things which thou art about to suffer: behold, the devil is about to cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days. Be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee the crown of life.

title: Revelation of John 2:11
text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches. He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.

title: Revelation of John 2:12
text: and to the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These things saith he that hath the sharp two-edged sword:

title: Revelation of John 2:13
text: I know where thou dwellest, [even] where Satan's throne is; and thou holdest fast my name, and didst not deny my faith, even in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwelleth.

title: Revelation of John 2:14
text: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there some that hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit fornication.

title: Revelation of John 2:15
text: So hast thou also some that hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans in like manner.

title: Revelation of John 2:16
text: Repent therefore; or else I come to thee quickly, and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.

title: Revelation of John 2:17
text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches. To him that overcometh, to him will I give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and upon the stone a new name written, which no one knoweth but he that receiveth it.

title: Revelation of John 2:18
text: And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like unto burnished brass:

title: Revelation of John 2:19
text: I know thy works, and thy love and faith and ministry and patience, and that thy last works are more than the first.

title: Revelation of John 2:20
text: But I have [this] against thee, that thou sufferest the woman Jezebel, who calleth herself a prophetess; and she teacheth and seduceth my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed to idols.

title: Revelation of John 2:21
text: And I gave her time that she should repent; and she willeth not to repent of her fornication.

title: Revelation of John 2:22
text: Behold, I cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of her works.

title: Revelation of John 2:23
text: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he that searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto each one of you according to your works.

title: Revelation of John 2:24
text: But to you I say, to the rest that are in Thyatira, as many as have not this teaching, who know not the deep things of Satan, as they are wont to say; I cast upon you none other burden.

title: Revelation of John 2:25
text: Nevertheless that which ye have, hold fast till I come.

title: Revelation of John 2:26
text: And he that overcometh, and he that keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give authority over the nations:

title: Revelation of John 2:27
text: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron, as the vessels of the potter are broken to shivers; as I also have received of my Father:

title: Revelation of John 2:28
text: and I will give him the morning star.

title: Revelation of John 2:29
text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.

title: Revelation of John 3:1
text: And to the angel of the church in Sardis write: These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars: I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and thou art dead.

title: Revelation of John 3:2
text: Be thou watchful, and establish the things that remain, which were ready to die: for I have found no works of thine perfected before my God.

title: Revelation of John 3:3
text: Remember therefore how thou hast received and didst hear; and keep [it], and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.

title: Revelation of John 3:4
text: But thou hast a few names in Sardis that did not defile their garments: and they shall walk with me in white; for they are worthy.

title: Revelation of John 3:5
text: He that overcometh shall thus be arrayed in white garments; and I will in no wise blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

title: Revelation of John 3:6
text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.

title: Revelation of John 3:7
text: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth and none shall shut, and that shutteth and none openeth:

title: Revelation of John 3:8
text: I know thy works (behold, I have set before thee a door opened, which none can shut), that thou hast a little power, and didst keep my word, and didst not deny my name.

title: Revelation of John 3:9
text: Behold, I give of the synagogue of Satan, of them that say they are Jews, and they are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.

title: Revelation of John 3:10
text: Because thou didst keep the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of trial, that [hour] which is to come upon the whole world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.

title: Revelation of John 3:11
text: I come quickly: hold fast that which thou hast, that no one take thy crown.

title: Revelation of John 3:12
text: He that overcometh, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go out thence no more: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God, and mine own new name.

title: Revelation of John 3:13
text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.

title: Revelation of John 3:14
text: And to the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God:

title: Revelation of John 3:15
text: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.

title: Revelation of John 3:16
text: So because thou art lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will spew thee out of my mouth.

title: Revelation of John 3:17
text: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art the wretched one and miserable and poor and blind and naked:

title: Revelation of John 3:18
text: I counsel thee to buy of me gold refined by fire, that thou mayest become rich; and white garments, that thou mayest clothe thyself, and [that] the shame of thy nakedness be not made manifest; and eyesalve to anoint thine eyes, that thou mayest see.

title: Revelation of John 3:19
text: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.

title: Revelation of John 3:20
text: Behold, I stand at the door and knock: if any man hear my voice and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

title: Revelation of John 3:21
text: He that overcometh, I will give to him to sit down with me in my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father in his throne.

title: Revelation of John 3:22
text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.

title: Revelation of John 4:1
text: After these things I saw, and behold, a door opened in heaven, and the first voice that I heard, [a voice] as of a trumpet speaking with me, one saying, Come up hither, and I will show thee the things which must come to pass hereafter.

title: Revelation of John 4:2
text: Straightway I was in the Spirit: and behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting upon the throne;

title: Revelation of John 4:3
text: and he that sat [was] to look upon like a jasper stone and a sardius: and [there was] a rainbow round about the throne, like an emerald to look upon.

title: Revelation of John 4:4
text: And round about the throne [were] four and twenty thrones: and upon the thrones [I saw] four and twenty elders sitting, arrayed in white garments; and on their heads crowns of gold.

title: Revelation of John 4:5
text: And out of the throne proceed lightnings and voices and thunders. And [there was] seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God;

title: Revelation of John 4:6
text: and before the throne, as it were a sea of glass like a crystal; and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

title: Revelation of John 4:7
text: And the first creature [was] like a lion, and the second creature like a calf, and the third creature had a face as of a man, and the fourth creature [was] like a flying eagle.

title: Revelation of John 4:8
text: and the four living creatures, having each one of them six wings, are full of eyes round about and within: and they have no rest day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, [is] the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come.

title: Revelation of John 4:9
text: And when the living creatures shall give glory and honor and thanks to him that sitteth on the throne, to him that liveth for ever and ever,

title: Revelation of John 4:10
text: the four and twenty elders shall fall down before him that sitteth on the throne, and shall worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and shall cast their crowns before the throne, saying,

title: Revelation of John 4:11
text: Worthy art thou, our Lord and our God, to receive the glory and the honor and the power: for thou didst create all things, and because of thy will they were, and were created.

title: Revelation of John 5:1
text: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the back, close sealed with seven seals.

title: Revelation of John 5:2
text: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a great voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?

title: Revelation of John 5:3
text: And no one in the heaven, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book, or to look thereon.

title: Revelation of John 5:4
text: And I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book, or to look thereon:

title: Revelation of John 5:5
text: and one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not; behold, the Lion that is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, hath overcome to open the book and the seven seals thereof.

title: Revelation of John 5:6
text: And I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the midst of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns, and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent forth into all the earth.

title: Revelation of John 5:7
text: And he came, and he taketh [it] out of the right hand of him that sat on the throne.

title: Revelation of John 5:8
text: And when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having each one a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

title: Revelation of John 5:9
text: And they sing a new song, saying, Worthy art thou to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou was slain, and didst purchase unto God with thy blood [men] of every tribe, and tongue, and people, and nation,

title: Revelation of John 5:10
text: and madest them [to be] unto our God a kingdom and priests; and they reign upon earth.

title: Revelation of John 5:11
text: And I saw, and I heard a voice of many angels round about the throne and the living creatures and the elders; and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;

title: Revelation of John 5:12
text: saying with a great voice, Worthy is the Lamb that hath been slain to receive the power, and riches, and wisdom, and might and honor, and glory, and blessing.

title: Revelation of John 5:13
text: And every created thing which is in the heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and on the sea, and all things are in them, heard I saying, Unto him that sitteth on the throne, and unto the Lamb, [be] the blessing, and the honor, and the glory, and the dominion, for ever and ever.

title: Revelation of John 5:14
text: And the four living creatures said, Amen. And the elders fell down and worshipped.

title: Revelation of John 6:1
text: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying as with a voice of thunder, Come.

title: Revelation of John 6:2
text: And I saw, and behold, a white horse, and he that sat thereon had a bow; and there was given unto him a crown: and he came forth conquering, and to conquer.

title: Revelation of John 6:3
text: And when he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, Come.

title: Revelation of John 6:4
text: And another [horse] came forth, a red horse: and to him that sat thereon it was given to take peace from the earth, and that they should slay one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.

title: Revelation of John 6:5
text: And when he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, Come. And I saw, and behold, a black horse; and he that sat thereon had a balance in his hand.

title: Revelation of John 6:6
text: And I heard as it were a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying, A measure of wheat for a shilling, and three measures of barley for a shilling; and the oil and the wine hurt thou not.

title: Revelation of John 6:7
text: And when he opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, Come.

title: Revelation of John 6:8
text: And I saw, and behold, a pale horse: and he that sat upon him, his name was Death; and Hades followed with him. And there was given unto them authority over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with famine, and with death, and by the wild beasts of the earth.

title: Revelation of John 6:9
text: And when he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of them that had been slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:

title: Revelation of John 6:10
text: and they cried with a great voice, saying, How long, O Master, the holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?

title: Revelation of John 6:11
text: And there was given them to each one a white robe; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little time, until their fellow-servants also and their brethren, who should be killed even as they were, should have fulfilled [their course].

title: Revelation of John 6:12
text: And I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the whole moon became as blood;

title: Revelation of John 6:13
text: and the stars of the heaven fell unto the earth, as a fig tree casteth her unripe figs when she is shaken of a great wind.

title: Revelation of John 6:14
text: And the heaven was removed as a scroll when it is rolled up; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

title: Revelation of John 6:15
text: And the kings of the earth, and the princes, and the chief captains, and the rich, and the strong, and every bondman and freeman, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains;

title: Revelation of John 6:16
text: and they say to the mountains and to the rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:

title: Revelation of John 6:17
text: for the great day of their wrath is come; and who is able to stand?

title: Revelation of John 7:1
text: After his I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that no wind should blow on the earth, or on the sea, or upon any tree.

title: Revelation of John 7:2
text: And I saw another angel ascend from the sunrising, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a great voice to the four angels to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,

title: Revelation of John 7:3
text: saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we shall have sealed the servants of our God on their foreheads.

title: Revelation of John 7:4
text: And I heard the number of them that were sealed, a hundred and forty and four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:

title: Revelation of John 7:5
text: Of the tribe of Judah [were] sealed twelve thousand: Of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand;

title: Revelation of John 7:6
text: Of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand;

title: Revelation of John 7:7
text: Of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand;

title: Revelation of John 7:8
text: Of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Benjamin [were] sealed twelve thousand.

title: Revelation of John 7:9
text: After these things I saw, and behold, a great multitude, which no man could number, out of every nation and of [all] tribes and peoples and tongues, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, arrayed in white robes, and palms in their hands;

title: Revelation of John 7:10
text: and they cry with a great voice, saying, Salvation unto our God who sitteth on the throne, and unto the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 7:11
text: And all the angels were standing round about the throne, and [about] the elders and the four living creatures; and they fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,

title: Revelation of John 7:12
text: saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honor, and power, and might, [be] unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.

title: Revelation of John 7:13
text: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, These that are arrayed in white robes, who are they, and whence came they?

title: Revelation of John 7:14
text: And I say unto him, My lord, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they that come of the great tribulation, and they washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 7:15
text: Therefore are they before the throne of God; and they serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall spread his tabernacle over them.

title: Revelation of John 7:16
text: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun strike upon them, nor any heat:

title: Revelation of John 7:17
text: for the Lamb that is in the midst of the throne shall be their shepherd, and shall guide them unto fountains of waters of life: and God shall wipe away every tear from their eyes.

title: Revelation of John 8:1
text: And when he opened the seventh seal, there followed a silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.

title: Revelation of John 8:2
text: And I saw the seven angels that stand before God; and there were given unto them seven trumpets.

title: Revelation of John 8:3
text: And another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should add it unto the prayers of all the saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

title: Revelation of John 8:4
text: And the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel's hand.

title: Revelation of John 8:5
text: And the angel taketh the censer; and he filled it with the fire of the altar, and cast it upon the earth: and there followed thunders, and voices, and lightnings, and an earthquake.

title: Revelation of John 8:6
text: And the seven angels that had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

title: Revelation of John 8:7
text: And the first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of the earth was burnt up, and the third part of the trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

title: Revelation of John 8:8
text: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;

title: Revelation of John 8:9
text: and there died the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, [even] they that had life; and the third part of the ships was destroyed.

title: Revelation of John 8:10
text: And the third angel sounded, and there fell from heaven a great star, burning as a torch, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of the waters;

title: Revelation of John 8:11
text: and the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.

title: Revelation of John 8:12
text: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; that the third part of them should be darkened, and the day should not shine for the third part of it, and the night in like manner.

title: Revelation of John 8:13
text: And I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a great voice, Woe, woe, woe, for them that dwell on the earth, by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, who are yet to sound.

title: Revelation of John 9:1
text: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from heaven fallen unto the earth: and there was given to him the key of the pit of the abyss.

title: Revelation of John 9:2
text: And he opened the pit of the abyss; and there went up a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.

title: Revelation of John 9:3
text: And out of the smoke came forth locusts upon the earth; and power was given them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

title: Revelation of John 9:4
text: And it was said unto them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only such men as have not the seal of God on their foreheads.

title: Revelation of John 9:5
text: And it was given them that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when it striketh a man.

title: Revelation of John 9:6
text: And in those days men shall seek death, and shall in no wise find it; and they shall desire to die, and death fleeth from them.

title: Revelation of John 9:7
text: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared for war; and upon their heads as it were crowns like unto gold, and their faces were as men's faces.

title: Revelation of John 9:8
text: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as [teeth] of lions.

title: Revelation of John 9:9
text: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots, of many horses rushing to war.

title: Revelation of John 9:10
text: And they have tails like unto scorpions, and stings; and in their tails is their power to hurt men five months.

title: Revelation of John 9:11
text: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss: his name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in the Greek [tongue] he hath the name Apollyon.

title: Revelation of John 9:12
text: The first Woe is past: behold, there come yet two Woes hereafter.

title: Revelation of John 9:13
text: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

title: Revelation of John 9:14
text: one saying to the sixth angel that had one trumpet, Loose the four angels that are bound at the great river Euphrates.

title: Revelation of John 9:15
text: And the four angels were loosed, that had been prepared for the hour and day and month and year, that they should kill the third part of men.

title: Revelation of John 9:16
text: And the number of the armies of the horsemen was twice ten thousand times ten thousand: I heard the number of them.

title: Revelation of John 9:17
text: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates [as] of fire and of hyacinth and of brimstone: and the heads of lions; and out of their mouths proceedeth fire and smoke and brimstone.

title: Revelation of John 9:18
text: By these three plagues was the third part of men killed, by the fire and the smoke and the brimstone, which proceeded out of their mouths.

title: Revelation of John 9:19
text: For the power of the horses is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails are like unto serpents, and have heads; and with them they hurt.

title: Revelation of John 9:20
text: And the rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood; which can neither see, nor hear, nor walk:

title: Revelation of John 9:21
text: and they repented not of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.

title: Revelation of John 10:1
text: And I saw another strong angel coming down out of heaven, arrayed with a cloud; and the rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire;

title: Revelation of John 10:2
text: and he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left upon the earth;

title: Revelation of John 10:3
text: and he cried with a great voice, as a lion roareth: and when he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

title: Revelation of John 10:4
text: And when the seven thunders uttered [their voices], I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying, Seal up the things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.

title: Revelation of John 10:5
text: And the angel that I saw standing upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his right hand to heaven,

title: Revelation of John 10:6
text: and sware by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created the heaven and the things that are therein, and the earth and the things that are therein, and the sea and the things that are therein, that there shall be delay no longer:

title: Revelation of John 10:7
text: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then is finished they mystery of God, according to the good tidings which he declared to his servants the prophets.

title: Revelation of John 10:8
text: And the voice which I heard from heaven, [I heard it] again speaking with me, and saying, Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel that standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.

title: Revelation of John 10:9
text: And I went unto the angel, saying unto him that he should give me the little book. And he saith unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but in thy mouth it shall be sweet as honey.

title: Revelation of John 10:10
text: And I took the little book out of the angel's hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and when I had eaten it, my belly was made bitter.

title: Revelation of John 10:11
text: And they say unto me, Thou must prophesy again over many peoples and nations and tongues and kings.

title: Revelation of John 11:1
text: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and one said, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.

title: Revelation of John 11:2
text: And the court which is without the temple leave without, and measure it not; for it hath been given unto the nations: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.

title: Revelation of John 11:3
text: And I will give unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.

title: Revelation of John 11:4
text: These are the two olive trees and the two candlesticks, standing before the Lord of the earth.

title: Revelation of John 11:5
text: And if any man desireth to hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth and devoureth their enemies; and if any man shall desire to hurt them, in this manner must he be killed.

title: Revelation of John 11:6
text: These have the power to shut the heaven, that it rain not during the days of their prophecy: and they have power over the waters to turn them into blood, and to smite the earth with every plague, as often as they shall desire.

title: Revelation of John 11:7
text: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that cometh up out of the abyss shall make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

title: Revelation of John 11:8
text: And their dead bodies [lie] in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

title: Revelation of John 11:9
text: And from among the peoples and tribes and tongues and nations do [men] look upon their dead bodies three days and a half, and suffer not their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

title: Revelation of John 11:10
text: And they that dwell on the earth rejoice over them, and make merry; and they shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwell on the earth.

title: Revelation of John 11:11
text: And after the three days and a half the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them that beheld them.

title: Revelation of John 11:12
text: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they went up into heaven in the cloud; and their enemies beheld them.

title: Revelation of John 11:13
text: And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell; and there were killed in the earthquake seven thousand persons: and the rest were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

title: Revelation of John 11:14
text: The second Woe is past: behold, the third Woe cometh quickly.

title: Revelation of John 11:15
text: And the seventh angel sounded; and there followed great voices in heaven, and they said, The kingdom of the world is become [the kingdom] of our Lord, and of his Christ: and he shall reign for ever and ever.

title: Revelation of John 11:16
text: And the four and twenty elders, who sit before God on their thrones, fell upon their faces and worshipped God,

title: Revelation of John 11:17
text: saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God, the Almighty, who art and who wast; because thou hast taken thy great power, and didst reign.

title: Revelation of John 11:18
text: And the nations were wroth, and thy wrath came, and the time of the dead to be judged, and [the time] to give their reward to thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and to them that fear thy name, the small and the great; and to destroy them that destroy the earth.

title: Revelation of John 11:19
text: And there was opened the temple of God that is in heaven; and there was seen in his temple the ark of his covenant; and there followed lightnings, and voices, and thunders, and an earthquake, and great hail.

title: Revelation of John 12:1
text: And a great sign was seen in heaven: a woman arrayed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars;

title: Revelation of John 12:2
text: and she was the child; and she crieth out, travailing in birth, and in pain to be delivered.

title: Revelation of John 12:3
text: And there was seen another sign in heaven: and behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his heads seven diadems.

title: Revelation of John 12:4
text: And his tail draweth the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon standeth before the woman that is about to be delivered, that when she is delivered he may devour her child.

title: Revelation of John 12:5
text: And she was delivered of a son, a man child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and unto his throne.

title: Revelation of John 12:6
text: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that there they may nourish her a thousand two hundred and threescore days.

title: Revelation of John 12:7
text: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels [going forth] to war with the dragon; and the dragon warred and his angels;

title: Revelation of John 12:8
text: And they prevailed not, neither was their place found any more in heaven.

title: Revelation of John 12:9
text: And the great dragon was cast down, the old serpent, he that is called the Devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world; he was cast down to the earth, and his angels were cast down with him.

title: Revelation of John 12:10
text: And I heard a great voice in heaven, saying, Now is come the salvation, and the power, and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, who accuseth them before our God day and night.

title: Revelation of John 12:11
text: And they overcame him because of the blood of the Lamb, and because of the word of their testimony; and they loved not their life even unto death.

title: Revelation of John 12:12
text: Therefore rejoice, O heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe for the earth and for the sea: because the devil is gone down unto you, having great wrath, knowing that he hath but a short time.

title: Revelation of John 12:13
text: And when the dragon saw that he was cast down to the earth, he persecuted the woman that brought forth the man [child].

title: Revelation of John 12:14
text: And there were given to the woman the two wings of the great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness unto her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

title: Revelation of John 12:15
text: And the serpent cast out of his mouth after the woman water as a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.

title: Revelation of John 12:16
text: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon cast out of his mouth.

title: Revelation of John 12:17
text: And the dragon waxed wroth with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her seed, that keep the commandments of God, and hold the testimony of Jesus:

title: Revelation of John 13:1
text: and he stood upon the sand of the sea. And I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns, and seven heads, and on his horns ten diadems, and upon his heads names of blasphemy.

title: Revelation of John 13:2
text: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as [the feet] of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his throne, and great authority.

title: Revelation of John 13:3
text: And [I saw] one of his heads as though it had been smitten unto death; and his death-stroke was healed: and the whole earth wondered after the beast;

title: Revelation of John 13:4
text: and they worshipped the dragon, because he gave his authority unto the beast; and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? And who is able to war with him?

title: Revelation of John 13:5
text: and there was given to him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and there was given to him authority to continue forty and two months.

title: Revelation of John 13:6
text: And he opened his mouth for blasphemies against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, [even] them that dwell in the heaven.

title: Revelation of John 13:7
text: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and there was given to him authority over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.

title: Revelation of John 13:8
text: And all that dwell on the earth shall worship him, [every one] whose name hath not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb that hath been slain.

title: Revelation of John 13:9
text: If any man hath an ear, let him hear.

title: Revelation of John 13:10
text: If any man [is] for captivity, into captivity he goeth: if any man shall kill with the sword, with the sword must he be killed. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.

title: Revelation of John 13:11
text: And I saw another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like unto lamb, and he spake as a dragon.

title: Revelation of John 13:12
text: And he exerciseth all the authority of the first beast in his sight. And he maketh the earth and them dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose death-stroke was healed.

title: Revelation of John 13:13
text: And he doeth great signs, that he should even make fire to come down out of heaven upon the earth in the sight of men.

title: Revelation of John 13:14
text: And he deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by reason of the signs which it was given him to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast who hath the stroke of the sword and lived.

title: Revelation of John 13:15
text: And it was given [unto him] to give breath to it, [even] to the image to the breast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as should not worship the image of the beast should be killed.

title: Revelation of John 13:16
text: And he causeth all, the small and the great, and the rich and the poor, and the free and the bond, that there be given them a mark on their right hand, or upon their forehead;

title: Revelation of John 13:17
text: and that no man should be able to buy or to sell, save he that hath the mark, [even] the name of the beast or the number of his name.

title: Revelation of John 13:18
text: Here is wisdom. He that hath understanding, let him count the number of the beast; for it is the number of a man: and his number is Six hundred and sixty and six.

title: Revelation of John 14:1
text: And I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on the mount Zion, and with him a hundred and forty and four thousand, having his name, and the name of his Father, written on their foreheads.

title: Revelation of John 14:2
text: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and the voice which I heard [was] as [the voice] of harpers harping with their harps:

title: Revelation of John 14:3
text: and they sing as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four living creatures and the elders: and no man could learn the song save the hundred and forty and four thousand, [even] they that had been purchased out of the earth.

title: Revelation of John 14:4
text: These are they that were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These [are] they that follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were purchased from among men, [to be] the firstfruits unto God and unto the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 14:5
text: And in their mouth was found no lie: they are without blemish.

title: Revelation of John 14:6
text: And I saw another angel flying in mid heaven, having eternal good tidings to proclaim unto them that dwell on the earth, and unto every nation and tribe and tongue and people;

title: Revelation of John 14:7
text: and he saith with a great voice, Fear God, and give him glory; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made the heaven and the earth and sea and fountains of waters.

title: Revelation of John 14:8
text: And another, a second angel, followed, saying, Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, that hath made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.

title: Revelation of John 14:9
text: And another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, If any man worshippeth the beast and his image, and receiveth a mark on his forehead, or upon his hand,

title: Revelation of John 14:10
text: he also shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:

title: Revelation of John 14:11
text: and the smoke of their torment goeth up for ever and ever; and they have no rest day and night, they that worship the beast and his image, and whoso receiveth the mark of his name.

title: Revelation of John 14:12
text: Here is the patience of the saints, they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.

title: Revelation of John 14:13
text: And I heard the voice from heaven saying, Write, Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from henceforth: yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labors; for their works follow with them.

title: Revelation of John 14:14
text: And I saw, and behold, a white cloud; and on the cloud [I saw] one sitting like unto a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand sharp sickle.

title: Revelation of John 14:15
text: And another angel came out from the temple, crying with a great voice to him that sat on the cloud, Send forth thy sickle, and reap: for the hour to reap is come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.

title: Revelation of John 14:16
text: And he that sat on the cloud cast his sickle upon the earth; and the earth was reaped.

title: Revelation of John 14:17
text: Another angel came out from the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.

title: Revelation of John 14:18
text: And another angel came out from the altar, he that hath power over fire; and he called with a great voice to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Send forth thy sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.

title: Revelation of John 14:19
text: And the angel cast his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth, and cast it into the winepress, the great [winepress], of the wrath of God.

title: Revelation of John 14:20
text: And the winepress are trodden without the city, and there came out blood from the winepress, even unto the bridles of the horses, as far as a thousand and six hundred furlongs.

title: Revelation of John 15:1
text: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having seven plagues, [which are] the last, for in them is finished the wrath of God.

title: Revelation of John 15:2
text: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire; and them that come off victorious from the beast, and from his image, and from the number of his name, standing by the sea of glass, having harps of God.

title: Revelation of John 15:3
text: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, O Lord God, the Almighty; righteous and true are thy ways, thou King of the ages.

title: Revelation of John 15:4
text: Who shall not fear, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy; for all the nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy righteous acts have been made manifest.

title: Revelation of John 15:5
text: And after these things I saw, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:

title: Revelation of John 15:6
text: and there came out from the temple the seven angels that had the seven plagues, arrayed with [precious] stone, pure [and] bright, and girt about their breasts with golden girdles.

title: Revelation of John 15:7
text: And one of the four living creatures gave unto the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.

title: Revelation of John 15:8
text: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and none was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels should be finished.

title: Revelation of John 16:1
text: And I heard a great voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, Go ye, and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God into the earth.

title: Revelation of John 16:2
text: And the first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth; and it became a noisome and grievous sore upon the men that had the mark of the beast, and that worshipped his image.

title: Revelation of John 16:3
text: And the second poured out his bowl into the sea; and it became blood as of a dead man; and every living soul died, [even] the things that were in the sea.

title: Revelation of John 16:4
text: And the third poured out his bowl into the rivers and the fountains of the waters; and it became blood.

title: Revelation of John 16:5
text: And I heard the angel of the waters saying, Righteous art thou, who art and who wast, thou Holy One, because thou didst thus judge:

title: Revelation of John 16:6
text: for they poured out the blood of the saints and the prophets, and blood hast thou given them to drink: they are worthy.

title: Revelation of John 16:7
text: And I heard the altar saying, Yea, O Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are thy judgments.

title: Revelation of John 16:8
text: And the fourth poured out his bowl upon the sun; and it was given unto it to scorch men with fire.

title: Revelation of John 16:9
text: And men were scorched men with great heat: and they blasphemed the name of God who hath the power over these plagues; and they repented not to give him glory.

title: Revelation of John 16:10
text: And the fifth poured out his bowl upon the throne of the beast; and his kingdom was darkened; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,

title: Revelation of John 16:11
text: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores; and they repented not of their works.

title: Revelation of John 16:12
text: And the sixth poured out his bowl upon the great river, the [river] Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way might by made ready for the kings that [come] from the sunrising.

title: Revelation of John 16:13
text: And I saw [coming] out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, as it were frogs:

title: Revelation of John 16:14
text: for they are spirits of demons, working signs; which go forth unto the kings of the whole world, to gather them together unto the war of the great day of God, the Almighty.

title: Revelation of John 16:15
text: (Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walked naked, and they see his shame.)

title: Revelation of John 16:16
text: And they gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew Har-magedon.

title: Revelation of John 16:17
text: And the seventh poured out his bowl upon the air; and there came forth a great voice out of the temple, from the throne, saying, It is done:

title: Revelation of John 16:18
text: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since there were men upon the earth, so great an earthquake, so mighty.

title: Revelation of John 16:19
text: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

title: Revelation of John 16:20
text: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

title: Revelation of John 16:21
text: And great hail, [every stone] about the weight of a talent, cometh down out of heaven upon men: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof is exceeding great.

title: Revelation of John 17:1
text: And there came one of the seven angels that had the seven bowls, and spake with me, saying, Come hither, I will show thee the judgment of the great harlot that sitteth upon many waters;

title: Revelation of John 17:2
text: with whom the kings of the earth committed fornication, and they that dwell in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her fornication.

title: Revelation of John 17:3
text: And he carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness: and I saw a woman sitting upon a scarlet-colored beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.

title: Revelation of John 17:4
text: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stone and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations, even the unclean things of her fornication,

title: Revelation of John 17:5
text: and upon her forehead a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE HARLOTS AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.

title: Revelation of John 17:6
text: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. And when I saw her, I wondered with a great wonder.

title: Revelation of John 17:7
text: And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou wonder? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and the ten horns.

title: Revelation of John 17:8
text: The beast that thou sawest was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss, and to go into perdition. And they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, [they] whose name hath not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast, how that he was, and is not, and shall come.

title: Revelation of John 17:9
text: Here is the mind that hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth:

title: Revelation of John 17:10
text: and they are seven kings; the five are fallen, the one is, the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a little while.

title: Revelation of John 17:11
text: And the beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goeth into perdition.

title: Revelation of John 17:12
text: And the ten horns that thou sawest are ten kings, who have received no kingdom as yet; but they receive authority as kings, with the beast, for one hour.

title: Revelation of John 17:13
text: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority unto the beast.

title: Revelation of John 17:14
text: These shall war against the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them, for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings; and they [also shall overcome] that are with him, called and chosen and faithful.

title: Revelation of John 17:15
text: And he saith unto me, The waters which thou sawest, where the harlot sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.

title: Revelation of John 17:16
text: And the ten horns which thou sawest, and the beast, these shall hate the harlot, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and shall burn her utterly with fire.

title: Revelation of John 17:17
text: For God did put in their hearts to do his mind, and to come to one mind, and to give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.

title: Revelation of John 17:18
text: And the woman whom thou sawest is the great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.

title: Revelation of John 18:1
text: After these things I saw another angel coming down out of heaven, having great authority; and the earth was lightened with his glory.

title: Revelation of John 18:2
text: And he cried with a mighty voice, saying, Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and is become a habitation of demons, and a hold of every unclean spirit, and a hold of every unclean and hateful bird.

title: Revelation of John 18:3
text: For by the wine of the wrath of her fornication all the nations are fallen; and the kings of the earth committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth waxed rich by the power of her wantonness.

title: Revelation of John 18:4
text: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come forth, my people, out of her, that ye have no fellowship with her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues:

title: Revelation of John 18:5
text: for her sins have reached even unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.

title: Revelation of John 18:6
text: Render unto her even as she rendered, and double [unto her] the double according to her works: in the cup which she mingled, mingle unto her double.

title: Revelation of John 18:7
text: How much soever she glorified herself, and waxed wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall in no wise see mourning.

title: Revelation of John 18:8
text: Therefore in one day shall her plagues come, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire; for strong is the Lord God who judged her.

title: Revelation of John 18:9
text: And the kings of the earth, who committed fornication and lived wantonly with her, shall weep and wail over her, when they look upon the smoke of her burning,

title: Revelation of John 18:10
text: standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.

title: Revelation of John 18:11
text: And the merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no man buyeth their merchandise any more;

title: Revelation of John 18:12
text: merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stone, and pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet; and all thyine wood, and every vessel of ivory, and every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;

title: Revelation of John 18:13
text: and cinnamon, and spice, and incense, and ointment, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and cattle, and sheep; and [merchandise] of horses and chariots and slaves; and souls of men.

title: Revelation of John 18:14
text: And the fruits which thy soul lusted after are gone from thee, and all things that were dainty and sumptuous are perished from thee, and [men] shall find them no more at all.

title: Revelation of John 18:15
text: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning;

title: Revelation of John 18:16
text: saying, Woe, woe, the great city, she that was arrayed in fine linen and purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stone and pearl!

title: Revelation of John 18:17
text: for in an hour so great riches is made desolate. And every shipmaster, and every one that saileth any wither, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood afar off,

title: Revelation of John 18:18
text: and cried out as they looked upon the smoke of her burning, saying, What [city] is like the great city?

title: Revelation of John 18:19
text: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, Woe, woe, the great city, wherein all that had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.

title: Revelation of John 18:20
text: Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye saints, and ye apostles, and ye prophets; for God hath judged your judgment on her.

title: Revelation of John 18:21
text: And a strong angel took up a stone as it were a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with a mighty fall shall Babylon, the great city, be cast down, and shall be found no more at all.

title: Revelation of John 18:22
text: And the voice of harpers and minstrels and flute-players and trumpeters shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft, shall be found any more at all in thee; and the voice of a mill shall be heard no more at all in thee;

title: Revelation of John 18:23
text: and the light of a lamp shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the princes of the earth; for with thy sorcery were all the nations deceived.

title: Revelation of John 18:24
text: And in her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all that have been slain upon the earth.

title: Revelation of John 19:1
text: After these things I heard as it were a great voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, Hallelujah; Salvation, and glory, and power, belong to our God:

title: Revelation of John 19:2
text: for true and righteous are his judgments; for he hath judged the great harlot, her that corrupted the earth with her fornication, and he hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.

title: Revelation of John 19:3
text: And a second time they say, Hallelujah. And her smoke goeth up for ever and ever.

title: Revelation of John 19:4
text: And the four and twenty elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshipped God that sitteth on the throne, saying, Amen; Hallelujah.

title: Revelation of John 19:5
