text: And a voice came forth from the throne, saying, Give praise to our God, all ye his servants, ye that fear him, the small and the great.

title: Revelation of John 19:6
text: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunders, saying, Hallelujah: for the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigneth.

title: Revelation of John 19:7
text: Let us rejoice and be exceeding glad, and let us give the glory unto him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.

title: Revelation of John 19:8
text: And it was given unto her that she should array herself in fine linen, bright [and] pure: for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.

title: Revelation of John 19:9
text: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they that are bidden to the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are true words of God.

title: Revelation of John 19:10
text: And I fell down before his feet to worship him. And he saith unto me, See thou do it not: I am a fellow-servant with thee and with thy brethren that hold the testimony of Jesus: worship God; for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.

title: Revelation of John 19:11
text: And I saw the heaven opened; and behold, a white horse, and he that sat thereon called Faithful and True; and in righteous he doth judge and make war.

title: Revelation of John 19:12
text: And his eyes [are] a flame of fire, and upon his head [are] many diadems; and he hath a name written which no one knoweth but he himself.

title: Revelation of John 19:13
text: And he [is] arrayed in a garment sprinkled with blood: and his name is called The Word of God.

title: Revelation of John 19:14
text: And the armies which are in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white [and] pure.

title: Revelation of John 19:15
text: And out of his mouth proceedeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.

title: Revelation of John 19:16
text: And he hath on his garment and on his thigh a name written, KINGS OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.

title: Revelation of John 19:17
text: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in mid heaven, Come [and] be gathered together unto the great supper of God;

title: Revelation of John 19:18
text: that ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of them that sit thereon, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, and small and great.

title: Revelation of John 19:19
text: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat upon the horse, and against his army.

title: Revelation of John 19:20
text: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought the signs in his sight, wherewith he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast and them that worshipped his image: they two were cast alive into the lake of fire that burneth with brimstone:

title: Revelation of John 19:21
text: and the rest were killed with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, [even the sword] which came forth out of his mouth: and all the birds were filled with their flesh.

title: Revelation of John 20:1
text: And I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

title: Revelation of John 20:2
text: And he laid hold on the dragon, the old serpent, which is the Devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years,

title: Revelation of John 20:3
text: and cast him into the abyss, and shut [it], and sealed [it] over him, that he should deceive the nations no more, until the thousand years should be finished: after this he must be loosed for a little time.

title: Revelation of John 20:4
text: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and [I saw] the souls of them that had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus, and for the word of God, and such as worshipped not the beast, neither his image, and received not the mark upon their forehead and upon their hand; and they lived, and reigned with Christ a thousand years.

title: Revelation of John 20:5
text: The rest of the dead lived not until the thousand years should be finished. This is the first resurrection.

title: Revelation of John 20:6
text: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: over these the second death hath no power; but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.

title: Revelation of John 20:7
text: And when the thousand years are finished, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,

title: Revelation of John 20:8
text: and shall come forth to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.

title: Revelation of John 20:9
text: And they went up over the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down out of heaven, and devoured them.

title: Revelation of John 20:10
text: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where are also the beast and the false prophet; and they shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.

title: Revelation of John 20:11
text: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat upon it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.

title: Revelation of John 20:12
text: And I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne; and books were opened: and another book was opened, which is [the book] of life: and the dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.

title: Revelation of John 20:13
text: And the sea gave up the dead that were in it; and death and Hades gave up the dead that were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.

title: Revelation of John 20:14
text: And death and Hades were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death, [even] the lake of fire.

title: Revelation of John 20:15
text: And if any was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

title: Revelation of John 21:1
text: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth are passed away; and the sea is no more.

title: Revelation of John 21:2
text: And I saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven of God, made ready as a bride adorned for her husband.

title: Revelation of John 21:3
text: And I heard a great voice out of the throne saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he shall dwell with them, and they shall be his peoples, and God himself shall be with them, [and be] their God:

title: Revelation of John 21:4
text: and he shall wipe away every tear from their eyes; and death shall be no more; neither shall there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more: the first things are passed away.

title: Revelation of John 21:5
text: And he that sitteth on the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he saith, Write: for these words are faithful and true.

title: Revelation of John 21:6
text: And he said unto me, They are come to pass. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.

title: Revelation of John 21:7
text: He that overcometh shall inherit these things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.

title: Revelation of John 21:8
text: But for the fearful, and unbelieving, and abominable, and murderers, and fornicators, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, their part [shall be] in the lake that burneth with fire and brimstone; which is the second death.

title: Revelation of John 21:9
text: And there came one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls, who were laden with the seven last plagues; and he spake with me, saying, Come hither, I will show thee the bride, the wife of the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 21:10
text: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a mountain great and high, and showed me the holy city Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,

title: Revelation of John 21:11
text: having the glory of God: her light was like unto a stone most precious, as it were a jasper stone, clear as crystal:

title: Revelation of John 21:12
text: having a wall great and high; having twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels; and names written thereon, which are [the names] of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel:

title: Revelation of John 21:13
text: on the east were three gates; and on the north three gates; and on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.

title: Revelation of John 21:14
text: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 21:15
text: And he that spake with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.

title: Revelation of John 21:16
text: And the city lieth foursquare, and the length thereof is as great as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs: the length and the breadth and the height thereof are equal.

title: Revelation of John 21:17
text: And he measured the wall thereof, a hundred and forty and four cubits, [according to] the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.

title: Revelation of John 21:18
text: And the building of the wall thereof was jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto pure glass.

title: Revelation of John 21:19
text: The foundations of the wall of the city were adorned with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;

title: Revelation of John 21:20
text: the fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, topaz; the tenth, chrysoprase; the eleventh, jacinth; the twelfth, amethyst.

title: Revelation of John 21:21
text: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; each one of the several gates was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.

title: Revelation of John 21:22
text: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God the Almighty, and the Lamb, are the temple thereof.

title: Revelation of John 21:23
text: And the city hath no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine upon it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the lamp thereof [is] the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 21:24
text: And the nations shall walk amidst the light thereof: and the kings of the earth bring their glory into it.

title: Revelation of John 21:25
text: And the gates thereof shall in no wise be shut by day (for there shall be no night there):

title: Revelation of John 21:26
text: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it:

title: Revelation of John 21:27
text: and there shall in no wise enter into it anything unclean, or he that maketh an abomination and a lie: but only they that are written in the Lamb's book of life.

title: Revelation of John 22:1
text: And he showed me a river of water of life, bright as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,

title: Revelation of John 22:2
text: in the midst of the street thereof. And on this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve [manner of] fruits, yielding its fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

title: Revelation of John 22:3
text: And there shall be no curse any more: and the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be therein: and his servants shall serve him;

title: Revelation of John 22:4
text: and they shall see his face; and his name [shall be] on their foreheads.

title: Revelation of John 22:5
text: And there shall be night no more; and they need no light of lamp, neither light of sun; for the Lord God shall give them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

title: Revelation of John 22:6
text: And he said unto me, These words are faithful and true: and the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent his angels to show unto his servants the things which must shortly come to pass.

title: Revelation of John 22:7
text: And behold, I come quickly. Blessed is he that keepeth the words of the prophecy of this book.

title: Revelation of John 22:8
text: And I John am he that heard and saw these things. And when I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel that showed me these things.

title: Revelation of John 22:9
text: And he saith unto me, See thou do it not: I am a fellow-servant with thee and with thy brethren the prophets, and with them that keep the words of this book: worship God.

title: Revelation of John 22:10
text: And he saith unto me, Seal not up the words of the prophecy of this book; for the time is at hand.

title: Revelation of John 22:11
text: He that is unrighteous, let him do unrighteousness still: and he that is filthy, let him be made filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him do righteousness still: and he that is holy, let him be made holy still.

title: Revelation of John 22:12
text: Behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to render to each man according as his work is.

title: Revelation of John 22:13
text: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.

title: Revelation of John 22:14
text: Blessed are they that wash their robes, that they may have the right [to come] to the tree of life, and my enter in by the gates into the city.

title: Revelation of John 22:15
text: Without are the dogs, and the sorcerers, and the fornicators, and the murderers, and the idolaters, and every one that loveth and maketh a lie.

title: Revelation of John 22:16
text: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things for the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, the bright, the morning star.

title: Revelation of John 22:17
text: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And he that heareth, let him say, Come. And he that is athirst, let him come: he that will, let him take the water of life freely.

title: Revelation of John 22:18
text: I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, if any man shall add unto them, God shall add unto him the plagues which are written in this book:

title: Revelation of John 22:19
text: and if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.

title: Revelation of John 22:20
text: He who testifieth these things saith, Yea: I come quickly. Amen: come, Lord Jesus.

title: Revelation of John 22:21
text: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with the saints. Amen.
